name: cat_e_crlf_handling
description: cat -E: carriage return followed by newline displays as ^M$

name: cat_e_crlf_spanning_files
description: cat -E: \r\n spanning files/buffers is handled correctly

name: cat_e_cr_end_of_buffer
description: cat -E: \r at end of buffer followed by \n in next file

name: cat_v_immediate_output
description: cat -v: outputs processed data immediately (buffering test)
cmd_target: (dd count=1 if=fifo bs=1k 2>/dev/null & pid=$!; (echo 1; sleep 0.1; echo 2) | timeout 0.3 BINARY -v > fifo; wait $pid)

name: cat_self_append_fail
description: cat: appending file to itself should fail

name: cat_self_posix_overwrite
description: cat: POSIX-specified behavior - cat doc doc.end > doc
cmd_prep: echo x > doc && echo y > doc.end

name: cat_self_two_files_to_new
description: cat: two different files to new output file works
cmd_prep: echo x > fx && echo y > fy

name: cat_self_stdin_with_redirect
description: cat: stdin and file with bidirectional redirect
cmd_prep: echo x > fx && echo y > fy && echo -e 'x\ny' > fxy1

name: cat_self_files_with_redirect
cmd_prep: echo x > fx && echo y > fy && echo x > fxy2

name: cat_self_same_file_twice_fail
description: cat: same input file twice with bidirectional redirect should fail
cmd_prep: echo x > fx && echo x > fx3

name: cat_self_stdin_redir_fail
description: cat: stdin from file with bidirectional redirect to same file should fail
cmd_prep: echo x > fx && echo x > fx4

name: cat_self_append_same_fail
description: cat: appending file to itself with >> should fail

name: cat_self_stdin_append_fail
description: cat: reading stdin and appending to same file should fail

name: cat_self_single_file_works
description: cat: single file to itself with bidirectional redirect works
cmd_prep: echo x > fx && echo x > fx_copy
